REQUIRED-CENTRAL-IDEA: A readable-content engine should identify the document's main argument before it thinks about Markdown syntax. This ordering keeps navigation labels, advertisements, and subscription prompts from becoming apparently legitimate prose.

REQUIRED-EVIDENCE: Conservative cleanup combines semantic containers with text density, link density, and stable noise patterns. Each signal is imperfect alone, so the implementation records attempts and chooses a fallback only when the primary result is genuinely weak.

## Preserving useful structure

REQUIRED-STRUCTURE: Headings, code, tables, images, footnotes, and mathematical notation carry meaning. A good cleaner preserves those structures while an unconditional security boundary removes scripts, event handlers, and dangerous links.

```rust
fn extract_then_render() { println!("clean HTML is canonical"); }
```

| Stage | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Extract | Find and clean the main content |
| Render | Derive Markdown or text |

![Readable content pipeline](/images/pipeline.png) The relative image and [detail link](/details) should resolve against the supplied base URL.

<sup>1</sup> REQUIRED-FOOTNOTE: Debug evidence must be bounded so diagnostics remain useful without retaining an entire private page.
